qualification.details: Qualification and experience differ by post. Candidates should check the conditions for the post they are applying for. | Essential: Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or Technology from a recognized University or Institute in (a) Materials Engineering/Materials Science & Engineering/Metallurgical Engineering/Materials & Metallurgical Engineering, or (b) Mechanical Engineering. Desirable: (i) Master's Degree from a recognized University or Institute in any of the above disciplines; (ii) one year experience in Research and Development in Industry or R&D or Academic Institutions or Science and Technology Organizations. Job requirement: Work in ongoing R&D projects in broad areas of Energy materials and Systems, Surface Engineering, Ceramics, Carbon Materials, Powder Metallurgy etc. | Essential: (i) B.Sc. in Physical Sciences (with Chemistry as one of the subjects) or equivalent from a recognized University/Institute; OR (ii) three (3) years' full-time Diploma in Metallurgy/Mechanical/Electrical Engineering or equivalent from a recognized Board of Technical Education of Central or State Government. Desirable: (i) Prior technical experience in Industry/R&D laboratories; (ii) good interpersonal and communication skills with multi-tasking ability. Job requirement: Attached to one of the Centres to assist and provide technical support to Scientific & Technical Staff in R&D projects/programmes; operate and maintain R&D equipment/instruments; look after laboratory facilities including SOPs and Safety Protocols; assist in other allied works. Note: This is an entry-level post in the technical category. Candidates possessing higher qualifications such as M.Sc./B.Tech./B.E./M.Tech./M.E./M.S./Ph.D. in any subject or discipline as on the crucial date of eligibility will not be considered, and candidates with branches other than those specified will also not be considered. If, after verification of certificates at joining or thereafter, a selected candidate does not fulfil the essential qualifications, possesses higher qualifications, or any claim/certificate/document is found forged/invalid/fraudulent or information is suppressed, the appointment is liable to be cancelled/terminated at any time and legal action may be initiated. | Essential qualification: (i) 10th/SSC pass; plus (ii) 2 years full-time ITI in Fitter/Turner/Electrician trade from a recognized Board of Technical Education of Central or State Government. Essential experience: Three (3) years' technical experience in Industry/R&D laboratories. Desirable: (i) Sound knowledge of industrial equipment used for fabrication of components and assembly of systems; (ii) good interpersonal and communication skills with multi-tasking ability. Job requirement: Attached to one of the Centres/Sections to assist Scientific and Technical staff in operation and maintenance of R&D equipment and instruments including SOPs and Safety Protocols; maintain cleanliness and upkeep of laboratory facilities. Selected candidates may be assigned to any non-technical Centre/Section depending on work requirements and shall be willing to undertake any duties assigned, including work of a non-technical nature. Notes: This is an entry-level post in the technician category. Candidates possessing higher qualifications such as Diploma/B.Sc. or equivalent degree OR M.Sc./B.Tech./B.E./M.Tech./M.E./M.S. in any subject or discipline as on the crucial date of eligibility will not be considered, nor will candidates with branches other than those specified. Appointment is liable to be cancelled/terminated, and legal action may be initiated, if the selected candidate does not fulfil the essential qualifications, possesses higher qualifications, or any claim/certificate/document is found forged/invalid/fraudulent or information is suppressed. Experience includes Apprenticeship training/trainee experience and/or experience in Government Departments/Academic/Scientific Institutions/Autonomous Bodies/Research laboratories/Registered companies/Industries/Societies/MNCs/Private limited companies etc., and shall be supported by NPS/EPF & ESI membership. Without proper experience certificate, or with an experience certificate from unregistered companies/industries and/or individuals, experience will not be accepted. Part-time experience will not be considered for calculating years of experience. | Essential: (i) Pass in 10th/SSC or equivalent from a recognized Board; (ii) valid driving license to drive light and heavy vehicles; (iii) knowledge of motor mechanism (able to identify and rectify minor defects in vehicles); (iv) experience of driving light vehicles for at least three (3) years and heavy vehicles for at least six (6) years; (v) knowledge to maintain vehicle logbooks, journey records, fuel consumption details and other related documents. Desirable: (i) Sound knowledge of traffic rules, road safety regulations, vehicle documents and safe driving practices; (ii) capable of operating material-handling equipment such as forklifts and battery-operated trucks; (iii) basic knowledge of vehicle maintenance and troubleshooting of brakes, clutch, tyres, batteries and engine performance and other essential components; (iv) responsible for upkeep and cleanliness of vehicles operated by the Motor Transport Section; (v) attend official duties on holidays/during odd hours as and when required; (vi) good interpersonal and communication skills (in Hindi/Telugu) with multi-tasking ability. Job description: Attached to the Motor Transport Section; drive staff car, bus and other vehicles as assigned; ensure safe and timely transportation of officers, staff, research students, guests and materials; maintain upkeep, cleanliness and roadworthiness of vehicles and logbooks, journey records and fuel consumption details; promptly report vehicle defects and maintenance requirements; perform other duties assigned. Notes: Total prescribed experience should be after obtaining a valid LMV and HMV license. Experience certificates should only be from Army/Navy/Airforce (for Ex-servicemen)/Government Departments/Academic/Scientific Institutions/Autonomous Bodies/Research laboratories/State Road Transport Corporations/Registered Companies/Industries/Societies/Trusts/MNCs/Private limited companies etc., supported by NPS/EPF & ESI membership. Certificates without proper details or from unregistered companies/industries and/or individuals, and part-time experience, will not be accepted. | The crucial date of eligibility (cut-off date for qualification, experience and age) is not specified in the provided notification pages.

content_sections.heading: ARCI Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection begins with preliminary screening/short-listing of applications by a Committee constituted by the Competent Authority, ARCI. The Committee considers academic performance, relevance of experience for the post applied, number of years of relevant experience (based on data in the online application) and other parameters as deemed necessary. Screened-in candidates undergo a Computer Based Competitive Written Examination (CWE), followed by Personal Interview/Trade/Skill test (as applicable). ARCI may also administer any other selection method/tool/test at the sole discretion of the Competent Authority. For Officer "B", shortlisted candidates make a crisp presentation highlighting achievements across the broad spectrum of the work experience mentioned for the post, followed by a personal interview at ARCI, Hyderabad. The examination centre for CWE is Hyderabad only for all posts.

faq.question: Q1. What is ARCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: ARCI Recruitment 2026 is an official notification released by the International Advanced Research Centre for Powder Metallurgy & New Materials to fill 29 vacancies across multiple scientific, technical, administrative, and support posts.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in ARCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 29 vacancies advertised under advertisement number ARCI/HRD/RECT/1/2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for ARCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of online applications is 21 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Scientist B posts?
faq.answer: The age limit for Scientist B (R&D) is not exceeding 30 years.

faq.question: Q5. What educational qualification is required for Technical Assistant A?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Sc. in Physical Sciences with Chemistry as one of the subjects, or a three-year full-time Diploma in Metallurgy, Mechanical, or Electrical Engineering.

faq.question: Q6. What is the pay scale for Assistant A posts?
faq.answer: Assistant A posts are placed at Pay Level 5.

faq.question: Q7. Can Ex-Servicemen apply for Driver A posts?
faq.answer: Yes, preference will be given to Ex-Servicemen for the Driver A posts.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I submit the online application for ARCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can submit their online applications through the official ARCI careers portal at www.arci.res.in/careers/vacancies.
